Lead source: inbound (self-serve).
Primary contact: Priya Menon (CTO, priya@archipelagochat.com). Small B2B SaaS building embeddable in-app chat for SMB customers (help center + contextual in-app assistance).

Call highlights:
- Priya: 'main pain is streaming jitter; users expect instant token-by-token responses in-app'
- Target: P95 end-to-end streaming latency <150ms for short-turn conversations (<=120 tokens).
- Current stack: product uses React webchat + a lightweight websocket proxy; prototyped with public OpenAI streaming and saw 220-400ms P95 in EU region (unacceptable).
- Cost sensitivity: startup, tight margins; willing to pay for predictable pricing but needs clear unit economics for token-heavy sessions.
- Security: needs SOC2 soon (started audit), SSO for admin, and basic audit logs; data residency not strict yet (NA primary).
- Preferences: favor hosted API for speed to market but open to Dedicated if Redwood can prove latency/cost advantages.
- Quote from call: 'If you can show better latency at comparable cost, we'll switch from our current provider.'

Technical snapshots attached: Fireflies call id, POC trace, sample webchat traffic capture (see drive link).
